title: bomify plugin SecurityResult
description: The single JSON object a bomify-plugin-<type> binary must print to stdout on success for its "security scan" subcommand, per plugins/contracts/security/v1/CONTRACT.md. Its vulnerabilities and components are CycloneDX's own objects, referenced from CycloneDX's schema (1.7's definitions); this one adds only the bomify-specific requirements.

vulnerabilities.description: Every vulnerability the scanned --purl is affected by.

bom-ref.description: A stable identifier for this vulnerability (its id is a reasonable choice). bomify writes it into the scanned component's vulnerability report unchanged.

affects.description: Set by the plugin, not bomify. For a purl scanned directly (no "components" reported), a single entry referencing that same purl string back. For a purl unpacked into pieces ("components" is non-empty), one entry per affected piece, referencing its bom-ref from "components" - never the top-level purl itself.

components.description: Optional. Every piece the plugin found while unpacking the scanned --purl to scan it at all (e.g. the packages found by cataloging a container image). Omit entirely, or leave empty, if the plugin scanned the purl directly. bomify writes this list as the top-level components of the scanned component's vulnerability report, whose metadata component is the scanned --purl itself.

bom-ref.description: A stable identifier for this piece (a purl, if it has one, is a reasonable choice): what a vulnerability's affects[].ref points at when this piece is the one affected.

unscanned.description: Optional. Why the plugin couldn't analyze the component at all, e.g. nothing in its files it recognizes. bomify then counts the component as not scanned rather than clean, and ignores the rest of the result.
